candidates.tagline: The official World Cup ball: confusing NASA and goalkeepers simultaneously
candidates.story: Adidas designed the Trionda with a 500Hz sensor chip, deep seams, and fluid geometry — producing a ball so aerodynamically unpredictable that it has caused 19 goalkeeper errors in the tournament's opening weeks (nearly the same as all of Qatar 2022), while NASA simultaneously took one to the ISS to study why it behaves so oddly.
candidates.why_funny: Adidas over-engineered a round ball so thoroughly that it baffled both the world's best goalkeepers and the world's best physicists at the exact same time.
candidates.alt: Four NASA astronauts floating in zero gravity on the International Space Station, kicking and passing the official FIFA World Cup 2026 Trionda ball between them, with national flags visible on the wall behind

candidates.tagline: TfL failed to fix Tube flooding for 10 years. Beavers solved it in weeks.
candidates.story: London's Greenford Central Line station and surrounding streets flooded repeatedly for a decade despite engineering efforts; in June 2026 it emerged that five Eurasian beavers reintroduced to nearby Paradise Fields in 2023 had built natural dams that diverted the water entirely — no flooding since their first winter.
candidates.why_funny: Transport for London's expensive infrastructure team failed for a decade, and an animal that went extinct in Britain 400 years ago outperformed them within weeks of moving in.
candidates.alt: Close-up of a wet Eurasian beaver (Castor fiber) swimming in dark water, staring at the camera with small focused eyes
